source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/README.md §0.3 'The frame'; 'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' page artboards (frame grid `252px 1fr`, content grid `padding:20px 40px 40px; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 300px; gap:28px`); operator rulings 4.2 (nav card top margin), 5.1 (section treatment), 5.2 (one coloured rule per screen), 2.2/2.3/3.1 (the forbid list)
notes: The mount is the REAL AppShell wrapping DashboardBrief and RegulationDetailSurface, so the nav card, the content column, the dashboard section cards, the detail header and the detail action row are all in ONE measured tree. Composing the two surfaces together is an audit fixture, not a claim the product renders them together.

Nav card top margin is expected at 20px per operator ruling 4.2 ('margin: 20px 0 16px 16px so it aligns with the content column's 20px top padding. Fix it in the frame, once'). The artboard markup still shows 16px; the ruling supersedes it.

Ruling 5.1 requires a 3px graduated rule ABOVE each section title (full card width, top edge, no radius, linear-gradient(90deg,#5A5552,#5A5552 22%,rgba(90,85,82,.18))) and NO line below the title. Selector repair, train 58 (2026-09-07): the earlier `[data-section-rule]` selector never matched anything; the dashboard's Card DOES render the shared `SectionRule` component (`src/components/ui/SectionRule.tsx`, marker class `.cl-section-rule`, confirmed by direct source read this session, `src/components/dashboard/DashboardBrief.tsx` line ~121) — the check below now measures the real element.

Ruling 5.2's sitewide count ('one coloured rule per screen') cannot be counted reliably today: BandGradientRule renders an unmarked `div[aria-hidden="true"]`, and the four-band gradient is not distinguishable by computed style alone from the ImpactMeter ramp or the full MilestoneTimeline track, which are also green-to-red gradients at similar heights. This spec therefore checks the ONE permitted instance exactly (the nav card cap) and forbids a band-proportion rule inside a page masthead. Adding `data-band-rule` to BandGradientRule would make the sitewide count a one-line check; that is a recommendation for the fix lane, not a deviation.

children.name: nav card — band-proportion gradient cap (the ONE coloured rule, ruling 5.2)
children.note: README §0.2: 'The four-band gradient rule (3px, segment widths proportional to the live band counts) is the brand mark'. Ruling 5.2 keeps it in this one place sitewide.

children.note: README §0.3: 'padding: 20px 40px 40px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 300px; gap: 28px; align-items: start'. The dc.html page artboards carry the identical declaration.

children.name: section card — no line BELOW the title (ruling 5.1)
children.note: Ruling 5.1: 'Live 18a (border-bottom 2px solid #5A5552 under the text) is wrong: remove it... Section title itself: Anton uppercase, no divider, no underline.'

children.name: section card — the 3px graduated rule ABOVE the title (ruling 5.1)
children.note: Ruling 5.1: 3px, full width of the card, top edge, no radius, linear-gradient(90deg,#5A5552,#5A5552 22%,rgba(90,85,82,.18)). Applies to every panel/section card on every page.

children.name: section title type (ruling 5.1: Anton uppercase)
children.note: README type scale: 'Display: Anton, uppercase, letter-spacing:.04em — page titles (34/28), card titles (20)'. No per-context exception is stated.

children.name: detail title type
children.note: README §0.3 and the type scale: Anton uppercase, 28px on detail, letter-spacing .04em. Operator 1.2 named this element. Selector repair, train 58 (2026-09-07): the earlier `.cl-detail-title` class does not exist in the product; train 57 moved the detail title into the shared `ui/Masthead` component (via `DetailMasthead`, size="detail"), whose own title element carries `.cl-masthead-title` (`src/components/ui/Masthead.tsx`, confirmed by direct source read this session) — the selector below now measures the real element.

children.name: exactly one '+ Tag' trigger in the detail header (operator 3.2, mechanism repair train 58 2026-09-07)
children.note: Operator 3.2: 'The action-row + Tag is the only trigger. Applied workspace tags still render as a row under the title; that row displays tags, it does not carry the trigger.' Moved out of `forbid` (train 58, 2026-09-07): a `forbid` entry can only assert absence (count 0), but the legitimate action-row trigger itself matches this selector, so a `forbid` here always read NOT IN SPEC at the correct count of 1 — a false positive on the passing state, not a real finding. Expressed instead as a `count: 1` target, which is what ruling 3.2 actually requires (a second trigger would measure count 2, a real MISMATCH). Investigation, train 58 (2026-09-07): measured count is 5, not 1 or 2 — higher than either the passing or the single-known-defect state predicts. `:not(.cl-masthead)` (added this session) already excludes the masthead's own header, and this mount's fixture (PAGE_FRAME_FIXTURES) passes no workspace tags with 'Tag' in their name, so the extra matches are NOT the Masthead CommandBar and NOT a tag pill's own label. Not resolved this session — this lane found the count wrong but did not trace which five elements match; the fix lane should inspect the live DOM (`page.locator(...).allTextContents()` against this exact selector) before assuming which control is the duplicate, rather than trust this note's earlier guess of 'the legitimate trigger plus one duplicate'.

forbid.name: floating Ask AI button (bottom-right, every page)
forbid.reason: Operator 2.2: 'Remove the floating Ask AI button on every page (bottom-right). The masthead command bar is the ask. No floating control.' The text filter is needed because BackToTop.tsx carries the IDENTICAL `fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40` class set, so the bare selector matches two controls stacked at the same coordinates. BackToTop is outside every ruling in the operator's list and is left exactly as it is; it is logged here as an observation, not a finding.

forbid.name: a second CommandBar inside the detail header
forbid.reason: Operator 2.3: 'Remove the inline Ask about this [regulation…] bar from every detail masthead. The action row follows directly below the workspace tags row.' Selector repair, train 58 (2026-09-07): the bare `header .cl-command-bar` selector caught the ONE legitimate CommandBar too, because train 57's DetailMasthead (component doc: 'the shared ui/Masthead is mounted once at the top of every detail page, carrying... ONE scoped CommandBar') renders that command bar inside its own `<header class="cl-masthead">`, which is itself inside `[data-audit="regulation-detail"]`. `:not(.cl-masthead)` excludes that legitimate header so this forbid targets only a SECOND, different header carrying a command bar — which is what ruling 2.3 actually forbids.

forbid.name: HeroPriorityDropdown in the detail action row
forbid.reason: Operator 3.1: 'Remove the Immediate ▾ dropdown from the regulation detail action row… Action row is exactly Export brief (primary) · Share · ☆ Watch · + Tag.'

forbid.name: a band-proportion (coloured) rule inside a page masthead
forbid.reason: Ruling 5.2: the band-proportion gradient stays in ONE place sitewide (the nav card cap and its mobile equivalents). Every other 3px rule uses the dark grey gradation from 5.1.
